name: docs-drift-retry-budget
title: Docs drift — retry attempts became a time budget, documentation did not

pullRequest.title: Give retries a time budget instead of an attempt count
pullRequest.body:
A dead endpoint used to hold a notification for as long as five backed-off attempts took, which is unbounded in wall-clock terms and was the cause of last week's queue backlog.

Retries now run against a deadline: the worker keeps retrying while the budget lasts and gives up the moment it would exceed it. The number of attempts is whatever fits.
pullRequest.author: j-okafor
